title: AXP Earnings July 24, 2026: Small-Cap AI Robot Delivers 153% Return for Hedge Funds (AXP)
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
**BOSTON** \- **July 24, 2026** \- *PRLog* \--Tickeron Highlights AI Trading Technology Updates and Expanded Research Tools

Tickeron has released updated results for its AI-powered trading technology, highlighting the historical performance of an [AI Trading Robot](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/) strategy linked to American Express (AXP) earnings analysis. According to the company, the referenced strategy achieved a historical return of **127%**.

# Key Highlights

* [Tickeron](https://tickeron.com/) published historical performance results for an [AI Trading Robot](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/) focused on [**AXP**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AXP/) **earnings analysis**.
* The company expanded its computing infrastructure and upgraded its **Financial Learning Models (FLMs)** to enhance AI-driven market analysis.
* Tickeron is celebrating its **10th Anniversary** with discounts of up to **50%** on selected AI investment tools.
* **Ask AI** gives investors AI-assisted access to financial research, market data, and company analysis.

# AI Trading Technology

Tickeron's AI Trading Robots use Financial Learning Models (FLMs) to analyze market behavior, historical patterns, technical indicators, and financial data to generate trading signals.  
  
The reported AXP-related [AI Robot](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/) result of a 153% return reflects historical strategy performance data and does not represent a guarantee of future profits. Automated tools can assist traders with research and decision support, but users remain responsible for risk management and investment decisions.

[Tickeron](https://tickeron.com/) has also expanded its computing infrastructure and enhanced its FLM capabilities to deliver more advanced AI analysis and trading automation.

# Ask AI Expands Investment Research

Tickeron continues to develop **Ask AI**, its AI-powered financial research assistant that helps investors explore topics including:

* Stock price movements
* Market news
* Earnings reports
* Dividends
* Analyst price targets
* Insider transactions
* AI-generated forecasts
* Investment risks and opportunities
* Competitor comparisons

Ask AI combines real-time market data, financial news, analyst research, corporate events, and Tickeron's proprietary Financial Learning Models to provide structured investment insights.

According to Tickeron CEO **Sergey Savastiouk**, the company's goal is to combine artificial intelligence with financial data to make market research more accessible, efficient, and easier to understand.

# Market Environment

Investor attention remains centered on artificial intelligence, corporate earnings, and technology spending. As major companies continue investing heavily in AI infrastructure, markets are closely evaluating whether these investments will produce sustainable long-term growth.

AI-related stocks continue to experience elevated volatility as investors weigh earnings performance, valuations, and broader macroeconomic conditions.
